aliases: deposit a check into a new checking account

when.quote: Customers can deposit checks into their checking or savings accounts using mobile check deposit.

starts.note: customer: only when the customer wants to deposit a check (for example, to fund a newly opened savings account after declining a transfer, or to fund a newly opened checking account)
starts.quote: To help a customer deposit a check, give them the deposit_check_3847 tool.

info.about: The id of the account to deposit into (for example, the new savings or checking account)
info.ask: Which account would you like to deposit the check into?
What is the amount on the check?

steps.do: Unlock the account lookup tool if it is not already unlocked in this conversation (the customer must already be verified; if not, verify and log as in the first job).
steps.if: the account lookup tool is not already unlocked in this conversation
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Read the customer's accounts to get the destination account_id (for example, the new savings account) and its current balance
steps.if: the destination account_id is not already known from an earlier tool result
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Check the check amount against the destination class's daily mobile check deposit limit (Blue $2,500; Light Blue $2,000; Green Fee-Free $2,500; Green (checking) $3,000; Evergreen $3,500; Dark Green $1,500; Light Green $500; Purple $5,000; Gold Years $5,000; Bluest $10,000; Silver Plus $5,000). If it is above the limit, explain the limit and do not give the tool for that amount.
steps.if: the destination class has a documented daily mobile deposit limit
steps.quote: Plan larger check deposits ahead of time if they exceed the $2,500 daily mobile deposit limit.

steps.do: Give the customer the check deposit tool
steps.if: the customer wants to deposit a check and the amount is within the destination's daily mobile deposit limit
steps.quote: To help a customer deposit a check, give them the deposit_check_3847 tool.

steps.do: Tell the customer to call deposit_check_3847 with the destination account id and the check amount
steps.quote: Have the user call deposit_check_3847(account_id, check_amount) where account_id is the ID of the account they want to deposit into and check_amount is the amount of the check in USD.

steps.do: Customer deposits the check through call_discoverable_user_tool
steps.quote: Note: The agent cannot deposit checks on behalf of the customer - this action must be performed by the customer themselves through the mobile app.

steps.do: If the deposit returns an error, explain the documented fix (retake photos, add the endorsement, correct the amount to match the check) and have the customer resubmit. On a duplicate, tell them not to redeposit.
steps.quote: Amount mismatch: Edit the entered amount to exactly match the check and resubmit.

steps.do: Re-read the accounts to confirm the deposit and balance
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Unlock get_bank_account_transactions_9173 if needed and read the destination account's transactions to see the check deposit and whether it is posted or pending.
steps.if: the balance from verify_balance does not yet show the deposit, or the customer asks whether it went through
steps.quote: Agents can retrieve the transaction history for a customer's bank account (checking or savings) using the get_bank_account_transactions_9173 tool.

steps.do: Confirm the balance and the usual 1–2 business days for funds to become available
steps.quote: Standard deposits are typically available within 1-2 business days.

rules.rule: The agent never deposits a check itself; the customer runs deposit_check_3847.
rules.quote: Note: The agent cannot deposit checks on behalf of the customer - this action must be performed by the customer themselves through the mobile app.

rules.rule: The Silver Plus mobile deposit limit is $5,000 a day.
rules.quote: You can deposit checks through the mobile app up to a daily total of $5,000.

rules.rule: The Purple Account mobile deposit limit is $5,000 a day.
Blue Account mobile deposit limit is $2,500 a day
Light Blue Account mobile deposit limit is $2,000 a day
Evergreen Account mobile deposit limit is $3,500 a day
Green Account (checking) mobile deposit limit is $3,000 a day
Green Fee-Free Account mobile deposit limit is $2,500 a day
Dark Green Account mobile deposit limit is $1,500 a day
Light Green Account mobile deposit limit is $500 a day
rules.quote: Use mobile check deposit for up to $500 each day.

rules.rule: Gold Years Account mobile deposit limit is $5,000 a day
rules.quote: Mobile check deposit limit: $5,000 per day

rules.rule: Bluest Account mobile deposit limit is $10,000 a day
Some deposits get extended review; the expected availability date shows in the app
rules.quote: Certain deposits may be subject to extended review. You will see the expected availability date in the app after submission.

done_when: The customer has run deposit_check_3847 into the chosen account (within its daily mobile deposit limit), and the agent has confirmed the resulting balance from the account records, or the deposit's posted/pending status from the transaction history, with the usual 1–2 business day availability (or has explained how to fix a deposit error, or that the amount exceeds the account's daily limit).
